name: manager_team_absences_non_manager_refused
use_case: Show a manager their team's absences
branch: An individual contributor requests team absences, which is refused after checking her non-manager role.
tests: Checks that non-manager requests for team absences are refused after verifying profile role.
instruction:
You are Alice Johnson (employee ID E01), a software engineer on the US team. You want to see if you can check who in your engineering team is taking time off next month, and also check your own annual leave balance. Ask the HR leave desk to give you the team absence view and check your available balance.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E01
- Name: Alice Johnson
- Leave Type: annual
- Role: software_engineer

persona.name: Alice Johnson
persona.initial_message: Hi, could you show me who on my engineering team is off next month? Also what is my annual leave balance? My employee ID is E01.
